name: @emsenn/jsnode-content-computer
description: Content computer for jsnode workspaces: LLM-written, gate-checked documentation cultivated bottom-up from a package's introspected surface — symbol references first, composed into explanations and a README. Our code formats and verifies; the model supplies prose.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test
